# Setting Up Staff for the Till

# Point of Sale: Setting Up Staff for the Till

Staff sign in to the till with a PIN. Each person's **POS role** decides what they can do at the till.

---

## Two kinds of staff

Go to **User Management** and click **Add Staff**. You'll be asked which kind of person you're adding:

| Option | Use it for |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Add staff with OrderHub login** | Managers and anyone who also needs OrderHub on the web. They sign in to OrderHub with a 6-digit code sent to their email. Turn on **POS access** to let them use the till too. |
| **Add POS / film staff** | Counter staff who only use the till (and film staff who only use the lab's film tablet). No email address needed. They sign in with a PIN. |

![Add Staff](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/531b9066-538c-4c5e-a11e-a05ac202d44b.png)

---

## Adding a POS-only staff member

1. In **User Management**, click **Add Staff**, then **Add POS / film staff**.
2. Enter their **Full name** and choose a **POS role**.
3. Click **Create staff**.
4. OrderHub generates a **4-digit PIN** and shows it **once**. Share it with them directly.

![Adding POS Staff Member](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/8322f337-da46-410f-8b07-2979ee0d91b7.png)

---

## POS roles

| Role | What they can do |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Counter Staff** | Sell, take payments, mark orders picked up, and issue refunds within your refund rules. |
| **Supervisor** | Everything Counter Staff can do, plus void refunds and approve refunds that need a manager PIN. |
| **Manager** | Everything a Supervisor can do, plus view the shift report (X report) and close shifts and days (end of day). |

* Note: Manual discounts are controlled separately. In **POS Settings Explained**, see **Manual Discounts → Allowed roles**.
* Note: A role change applies the next time the person signs in at the till.

---

## PINs

* To give someone a new PIN, open them in **User Management** and use **Reset PIN** under **POS Access**. The new PIN is shown once.
* Staff with an OrderHub login can change their own PIN under **OrderHub POS PIN** → **Change PIN** (4–6 digits).
* At the till, too many wrong attempts lock the PIN screen for 5 minutes. The screen shows how many attempts are left.
* To stop someone using the till, turn off their POS access, or deactivate them.
